title: Klerksdorp Spheres Puzzle

scenes.text: The spheres were uncovered in the Witwatersrand Basin near Klerksdorp, South Africa.
Scientists date them to 2.8 billion years using radiometric methods.

scenes.label: UNKNOWN ORIGIN
scenes.sub: Current consensus favors natural formation through mineral precipitation, but the perfect geometry fuels speculation.

scenes.text: Follow if the unknown keeps you up at night.

description: Klerksdorp spheres are tiny, perfectly round iron formations dating back billions of years. While geology offers explanations, their flawless shape keeps the debate alive.
